paragraphs.text: Angremur was a kingdom, likely a city-state, during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Although its exact location is unknown, Angremur was a city-state or small kingdom on the continent of Terisiare during the Dark Age . At some point, the young king Rogan became inspired by the words of the goblinhunter Lacjsi and attacked the Flarg raiders near his country. This resulted in the massing goblins turning their focus on Rogan's lands, and causing large-scale destruction of his holdings, with many farms burned down in goblin raids, and many of his people killed and even eaten by the goblins. Rogan himself was cursed by blood magic cast by an enraged healer and was turned into a monster every night for some time until the farmer Torya Longshanks broke the curse with her blood.
